benefits.desc: When you are reduced to 0 or fewer hit points, you can use your reaction to move up to your Speed before falling unconscious. Moving in this way doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks.

benefits.desc: On the first turn that you start with 0 hit points and must make a death saving throw, you make that saving throw with advantage.

benefits.desc: When you take massive damage that would kill you instantly, you can use your reaction to make a death saving throw. If the saving throw succeeds, you instead fall unconscious and are dying.
